hypotheses.title: Historical Variance Risk Premium Industry Neutral
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Comparing 6-month call implied volatility against 60-day historical realized volatility isolates the empirical variance risk premium. Neutralizing by Industry eliminates sector macro tides while isolating company-specific risk overpricing.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns invert during unexpected broad equity market volatility shocks.

hypotheses.title: Pure Call Volatility Premia Sector Neutral with Turnover Compression
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Evaluating call implied volatility against Parkinson high-low volatility in pure 2-term form removes multi-factor composite drag. Applying Decay 6 compresses turnover into single digits, maximizing Fitness above the 1.50 threshold.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails when Parkinson intraday range expands faster than implied volatility.

hypotheses.title: Operating Cash Generation to Long-Term Debt Coverage
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Funds from operations (FOPO) scaled by long-term debt measures debt service solvency and credit safety. Firms with superior operational cash generation relative to debt burden trade at persistent quality premiums without income-statement earnings overlap.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms in distressed high-yield credit turnaround rallies.
